sources.entry: LubeLogger - Web-based vehicle maintenance and fuel mileage tracker. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/K8S/C#

summary.one_liner: LubeLogger is a self-hosted, open-source, web-based tracker for vehicle maintenance and fuel mileage.
summary.what_it_does: LubeLogger is a web application for logging vehicle maintenance and fuel mileage, meant to replace spreadsheets and paper receipts. The README says it is distributed as a Docker image and as a Windows standalone executable. A Kubernetes Helm chart maintained by Anza-Labs is also referenced. A live demo is available, and the README points to documentation, a troubleshooting guide, and an issue tracker. The README does not detail specific features beyond the description, and the screenshots and brochure it links are not included in the text provided.
use_cases: replace a spreadsheet for car expenses
how_to_run: Download the Docker image or the Windows standalone executable (see the Getting Started Guide linked in the README)
Kubernetes: install the Helm chart provided by Anza-Labs
notable: Live demo that resets every 20 minutes (login: test / 1234)
Available as Docker image or Windows standalone executable
Community Helm chart for Kubernetes from Anza-Labs
Uses LiteDB and optionally Npgsql (PostgreSQL) per its dependency list
caveats: The README does not state platform support beyond Docker and Windows
Detailed feature list is only available via linked documentation and screenshots
